name: Which Potion?
source:
Short, silly VN in which magic student Airi is given a test by her forgetful magic teacher to pick the potion bottle that will get her over the gorge. 

[From [url=https://kobato-games.itch.io/which-potion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部短小轻松的视觉小说：健忘的魔法老师给学生Airi出了一道考题，要她选出能帮助自己越过峡谷的魔药瓶。

[来源：[url=https://kobato-games.itch.io/which-potion]Itch.io[/url]]
